title: Input schema of the Broken link & SEO Auditor scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Seed URLs to start crawling from (site homepages or specific sections).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made by this crawler.

useBrowser.title: Use Playwright (for JS-rendered pages)
useBrowser.description: If true, use PlaywrightCrawler to measure load time and render JS-heavy pages (slower but more accurate).

followInternalOnly.title: Follow internal links only
followInternalOnly.description: If true, only follow links within the same host as each start URL.

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: If true, perform HTTP checks for external links (may increase runtime and requests).

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of parallel requests (CheerioCrawler). Lower for politeness.
